channel.title: Joe Hartmann Finds
channel.description: Joe Hartmann Finds is a growing collection of Amazon affiliate finds from Joe Hartmann's Pinterest boards, each with a short article and links to the pin and to Amazon.

item.title: Freezer Organizer Bins for 5-7 Cu.Ft Chest Freezers, 4-Pack – Stackable Storage Baskets
item.description: A closer look at the Goovilla 4-pack of coated metal freezer organizer bins for 5-7 cu. ft. chest freezers, with lowerable side handles, stable stacking rods, and an open wire design for air flow.

item.title: REALINN Under Sink Organizers 2-Pack – Adjustable 2-Tier Pull-Out Storage
item.description: A closer look at the REALINN 2-pack of height-adjustable, L-shaped under sink organizers with two pull-out drawers each, built from thickened steel for kitchen and bathroom cabinets.

item.title: Clear Plastic Storage Bins for Pantry, Fridge & Freezer – Kitchen Organizers and Containers
item.description: A closer look at a 4-pack of clear, BPA-free plastic storage bins for the pantry, fridge, freezer, bathroom, and closets, with a stackable design and simple hand-wash care.

item.title: Bamboo Drawer Organizer Set – Individual Wood Storage Trays for Kitchen, Desk & Bathroom
item.description: A closer look at the MapleGrace bamboo drawer organizer set, five individual wood trays in different sizes that you can arrange into a custom layout for utensils, office supplies, makeup, or jewelry.

item.title: 4.5-Inch Under-Bed Storage Containers, 4-Pack – Low Profile Bins with Handles
item.description: A closer look at a 4-pack of 4.5-inch-tall under-bed storage containers with linen sides, zip tops, clear windows, and reinforced handles for clothes, shoes, bedding, and off-season items.

item.title: UVIAHOMI 10-Tier Over-the-Door Shoe Organizer – Holds 20-30 Pairs, Door Shoe Rack
item.description: A closer look at the UVIAHOMI 10-tier over-the-door shoe organizer, a wide hanging rack with 20 clear-front pockets and four metal hooks that turns the back of a door into storage for 20 to 30 pairs.

item.title: Suction Cup Shower Caddy Organizer – No-Drill Bathroom Shower Shelf for Shampoo & Soap
item.description: A closer look at a no-drill suction cup shower caddy set with a medium and a large basket, built-in hooks, and drainage holes, designed for tile, glass, and other smooth shower walls.

item.title: SUPVAN T50M Pro Bluetooth Label Maker with Tape – Wireless Label Printer for Home Organizing
item.description: A closer look at the SUPVAN T50M Pro, an inkless thermal label maker that works with a free phone app and prints labels from 3/4 to 2 inches wide for bins, jars, cords, and files.

item.title: REALINN L-Shaped 2-Tier Pull-Out Under Sink Organizer – Cabinet Storage for Kitchen & Bathroom
item.description: A closer look at the REALINN L-shaped 2-tier under sink organizer, a metal pull-out unit with a narrow top basket that clears pipes and a sliding lower drawer for cleaning supplies and toiletries.

item.title: FINDMAG Heavy-Duty Black Magnetic Hooks 10-Pack – 85 LB+ Hooks for Fridge & Garage
item.description: A practical look at the FINDMAG 10-pack of black neodymium magnetic hooks, a no-drill way to hang keys, towels, tools, and utensils on the fridge, steel doors, filing cabinets, and garage racks.

item.title: Vacuum Storage Bags with Hand Pump – 20 Combo Space Saver Bags for Clothes, Bedding & Travel
item.description: A closer look at Cozy Essential vacuum storage bags, a 20-bag combo in five sizes, including roll-up travel bags, with a double-zip seal, triple-seal valve, and an included hand pump.

item.title: ANTOWIN 4-Piece Expandable Bamboo Drawer Dividers – Adjustable Organizers for Kitchen & Bedroom
item.description: A closer look at ANTOWIN expandable bamboo drawer dividers, a set of four spring-loaded dividers that expand from 17 to 22 inches and hold in place with foam-padded ends, no tools needed.

item.title: Rubbermaid Cleverstore 32 Qt Clear Bins with Lids, 6-Pack – Stackable Closet Organizers
item.description: A closer look at the Rubbermaid Cleverstore 32-quart clear storage bins, a 6-pack of stackable plastic bins with tight-fitting latching lids and recessed handles for closets and laundry rooms.

item.title: WEBI Over-the-Door Hooks – 6-Hook Towel & Coat Rack, No-Drill Door Hanger in Black
item.description: A closer look at the WEBI over-the-door 6-hook rack, a black lacquered metal door hanger with double hooks and foam padding that fits doors 1 3/8 to 1 3/4 inches thick with no drilling.

item.title: Bamboo 3-Tier Expandable Spice Rack Cabinet Organizer – Kitchen Shelf for Spice Jars & Bottles
item.description: A closer look at the Zri Bamboo expandable 3-tier spice rack, a moso bamboo step shelf that adjusts from 12.7 to 22.2 inches long so spice jars stay visible in a cabinet or pantry.

item.title: HOUSE DAY Black Velvet Hangers 60-Pack – Non-Slip, Space-Saving Clothes Hangers for Closets
item.description: A closer look at the HOUSE DAY black velvet hangers 60-pack, ultra-thin non-slip hangers with 360-degree swivel hooks that hold up to 11 lbs each and help save closet space.

item.title: SONGMICS 3-Tier Bamboo Shoe Rack Bench – Entryway Storage Bench for Shoes, 27.6 Inches Wide
item.description: A closer look at the SONGMICS 3-tier bamboo shoe rack bench, a 27.6-inch entryway bench with two shoe shelves and a top seat the brand rates to support up to 286 lb.

item.title: Simple Houseware 6-Shelf Hanging Closet Organizer – Space-Saving Sweater & Handbag Storage
item.description: A closer look at the Simple Houseware 6-shelf hanging closet organizer, a gray fabric tower with six 12-inch shelves and six side mesh pockets that hangs from a closet rod or wire rack.

item.title: Simple Houseware 10-Shelf Hanging Closet Shoe Organizer – Fabric Hanging Rack for Closet Shoes
item.description: A closer look at the Simple Houseware 10-shelf hanging shoe organizer, a fold-flat fabric tower with a metal dual-hook frame that hangs from a closet rod and supports up to 20 lbs.

item.title: Amazon Basics Over-the-Door Hanging Shoe Organizer – 24 Mesh Pockets for Shoes & Small Items
item.description: A closer look at the Amazon Basics 24-pocket over-the-door shoe organizer, a slim mesh caddy that hangs on three metal hooks and holds up to 12 pairs of shoes or 24 pairs of sandals.

item.title: REVLON One-Step Volumizer Plus Hair Dryer & Styler – 2.4 in Barrel, Black
item.description: A closer look at the REVLON One-Step Volumizer Plus, a hot air brush with a 2.4-inch oval head, four heat settings, and a detachable brush head that dries and styles in one step.

item.title: Pure Daily Care NanoSteamer Large 3-in-1 Nano Ionic Facial Steamer with Precise Temperature Control
item.description: A closer look at the Pure Daily Care NanoSteamer, a 3-in-1 nano-ionic facial steamer, room humidifier, and towel warmer with a 200 ml tank, auto shutoff, and a bonus 5-piece stainless steel skin kit.

item.title: Peach Slices Acne Spot Dots – 30 Count Hydrocolloid Pimple Patches for Face and Blemishes
item.description: A closer look at Peach Slices Acne Spot Dots, a 30-count pack of translucent hydrocolloid pimple patches in three sizes that absorb gunk, help stop picking, and can be worn under makeup.

item.title: Heatless Curling Rod Headband – No-Heat Silk Ribbon Hair Curler for Overnight Curls
item.description: A closer look at the BATOUDE heatless curling rod headband, a soft no-heat hair roller with a bonus claw clip for wrapping damp or dry hair and wearing it overnight for waves.

item.title: Microfiber Hair Towel Wrap 2-Pack with Button – Quick-Dry Turban for Long, Curly or Wet Hair
item.description: A closer look at the M-bestl 2-pack microfiber hair towel wrap, a lightweight, machine-washable hair turban with a loop-and-button closure that holds wet hair up while you get ready.

item.title: 100% Mulberry Silk Sleep Mask 2-Pack – Light Blocking Eye Masks for Sleeping, Travel & Naps
item.description: A closer look at the BeeVines mulberry silk sleep mask 2-pack, light-blocking eye masks with silk on both sides and an adjustable strap for home, travel, and naps.

item.title: HEETA Scalp Massager Shampoo Brush – Scalp Scrubber for Buildup, Dandruff-Prone Scalps & Hair Care
item.description: A closer look at the HEETA scalp massager, a soft silicone shampoo brush with an ergonomic handle for lathering, scalp scrubbing, and a relaxing shower massage.

item.title: Kitsch Ice Roller for Face – Cooling Facial Roller for Puffiness and Skin Care
item.description: A closer look at the Kitsch stainless steel ice roller, a freezer-friendly cooling roller for the face, under-eyes, and neck.

item.title: PLANTIFIQUE Jade Gua Sha & Face Roller Set – Facial Massage Tools for Depuffing and Glow
item.description: A closer look at the PLANTIFIQUE jade face roller and gua sha set, handcrafted jade tools in a giftable box, meant to be used with your favorite oil or serum.

item.title: BAIMEI IcyMe Rose Quartz Face Roller & Gua Sha Set – Depuffing Facial Massage Tools
item.description: A closer look at the BAIMEI IcyMe set, a rose quartz face roller paired with a gua sha stone for a cool, calming facial massage with your favorite oil or serum.

item.title: COSRX Snail Mucin 74% + Niacinamide 5% Dual Face Serum – Hydrating Korean Skincare, 2.7 oz
item.description: A closer look at the COSRX Advanced Snail Radiance Dual Essence, a two-in-one pump serum with a 74.3% triple snail complex and 5% niacinamide for hydration and radiance.

item.title: COSRX Snail Mucin 92% Moisturizer – Korean All-in-One Repair Face Cream, 3.52 oz
item.description: A closer look at COSRX Advanced Snail 92 All in One Cream, a lightweight gel-type moisturizer with 92% snail secretion filtrate, hyaluronic acid, and betaine for soft, hydrated, glowy skin.

item.title: Bio-Oil Skincare Body Oil Serum – Scars, Stretch Marks & Uneven Skin Tone, 2 fl oz
item.description: A closer look at Bio-Oil Skincare Oil in the 2 fl oz size, a lightweight, non-comedogenic face and body oil with vitamin E, chamomile oil, and lavender oil, made for the appearance of scars, stretch marks, and uneven skin tone.

item.title: L'Oreal Paris True Match Lumi Glotion Natural Glow Enhancer – Instant Bronzing Highlighter Lotion
item.description: A closer look at L'Oreal Paris True Match Lumi Glotion, a lightweight glow enhancer and tinted moisturizer with glycerin and shea butter that you can wear alone, mix with foundation, or use as a highlighter.

item.title: Real Techniques Miracle Complexion Sponge 4-Pack – Makeup Blending Sponges for Foundation
item.description: A closer look at the Real Techniques Miracle Complexion Sponge 4-pack, latex-free makeup blending sponges with a 3-point design for foundation, concealer, and cream products.

item.title: Aquaphor Advanced Therapy Healing Ointment – 7 oz Skin Protectant for Dry Lips, Hands & Cracked Skin
item.description: A closer look at the 7 oz tube of Aquaphor Healing Ointment, a fragrance-free, preservative-free petrolatum skin protectant for dry, cracked skin, chapped lips, and more.

item.title: Neutrogena Hydro Boost Hyaluronic Acid Water Gel Face Moisturizer – 24-Hour Hydration, 1.7 oz
item.description: A closer look at Neutrogena Hydro Boost Water Gel, a lightweight, oil-free, non-comedogenic hyaluronic acid gel moisturizer for normal, oily, and combination skin.

item.title: Cetaphil Moisturizing Cream for Face & Body – Dry, Sensitive Skin, 16 oz Tub
item.description: A closer look at Cetaphil Moisturizing Cream in the 16 oz tub, a fragrance-free face and body cream for dry to very dry, sensitive skin with glycerin, panthenol, and niacinamide.

item.title: CeraVe Moisturizing Cream – 19 oz Face & Body Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid & Ceramides
item.description: A closer look at the 19 oz tub of CeraVe Moisturizing Cream, a fragrance-free, non-comedogenic face and body cream with three essential ceramides and hyaluronic acid.

item.title: CeraVe Hydrating Facial Cleanser with Hyaluronic Acid & Ceramides – Gentle Daily Face Wash, 8 oz
item.description: A closer look at CeraVe Hydrating Facial Cleanser, a fragrance-free, non-comedogenic cream face wash with ceramides and hyaluronic acid for normal to dry skin.

item.title: Chuckit Classic 26-Inch Dog Ball Launcher with Medium Ultra Ball
item.description: A closer look at the Chuckit Classic 26-inch ball launcher, a made-in-USA thrower for dogs about 20 to 60 pounds that includes one medium Ultra ball and picks the ball up without a slobbery grab.

item.title: Snuggle Puppy Heartbeat Toy – Calming Comfort Plush for Medium Dogs
item.description: A closer look at the original Snuggle Puppy in medium biscuit, a plush comfort toy with a motion-activated SmartBeat heartbeat and a disposable heat pack for crate and first-night settling.

item.title: Portable Dog Water Bottle with Food Container and Filter for Travel
item.description: A closer look at the Cibaabo portable dog water bottle, a leak-resistant travel bottle with a built-in bowl, a detachable food container, a carbon filter, and a lock you operate with one hand.

item.title: Hands-Free Dog Leash with Waist Belt and Pouch – Large, 25-120 lbs
item.description: A closer look at the iYoShop large hands-free dog leash, a waist-belt lead for dogs about 25 to 120 pounds with dual padded handles, shock-absorbing bungees, and a removable zipper pouch.

item.title: Adjustable Dog Seat Belt – Nylon Car Safety Lead with Elastic Buffer
item.description: A closer look at the COOYOO dog seat belt, an adjustable 24- to 31-inch nylon lead with an elastic bungee buffer that clips to a harness and buckles into a car's seat-belt receiver.

item.title: Waterproof AirTag Holder for Dog Collar – Soft Slide-On Tracker Case
item.description: A closer look at the WhoseID waterproof slide-on AirTag holder, a soft silicone and ABS case that sits on a dog or cat collar so you can attach an Apple AirTag for walks.

item.title: BSEEN LED Dog Collar – USB Rechargeable Light-Up Safety Collar, Green
item.description: A closer look at the BSEEN USB-rechargeable LED dog collar in green, a cut-to-fit light-up collar with steady and flashing modes for night walks and backyard visibility.

item.title: Dog Doorbells for Potty Training – Adjustable Bells That Hang on the Door
item.description: A closer look at the BLUETREE dog doorbells, an adjustable nylon strap with seven 1.4-inch bells that hangs on a doorknob so a dog can ring when it is time to go out.

item.title: Amazon Basics 2-Door Hard-Sided Pet Carrier – Front and Top Entry
item.description: A closer look at the Amazon Basics hard-sided pet carrier, a 22.8 x 15 x 13 inch gray-and-blue kennel with front and top doors, steel wire, side vents, and a carry handle.

item.title: Bubble Backpack Pet Carrier – Clear Travel Backpack for Cats and Dogs
item.description: A closer look at the Texsens Innovative Traveler bubble backpack in black, a ventilated mesh pet carrier with a clear viewing window, chest buckle, and removable pad.
